column1: # Request-parameter surface for /render-api and the content-fetch endpoints.
# One row per (param, lane, source): what the renderer SHOULD do with it, and,
# where the code differs, what it IS doing. A blank `is` means the code matches
# `should`. `is` values are read from the code (2026-10-06) unless `ref` says
# lane:   problem | challenge | review | peer | ungrounded | content_fetch
#         session    = a request carrying a sessionJWT (prefix; combines with a body lane)
# source: raw (form/query) | claim (body JWT) | session (sessionJWT claim)
#         | peer (signed body) | sidecar (a verified revealJWT's grant)
#         honored    the value reaches the render and has its effect
#         overridden a claim or the lane sets it; the raw value is replaced
#         stripped   deleted before the lane; the default applies
#         tighten-only raw input may move it only toward the stricter value; ignored otherwise
#         rejected:N the request fails with HTTP N
# group:  envelope | reveal | grade | routing | diagnostic | presentation | telemetry
